title: Is Subsequence
description:
Given two strings s and t, determine whether s is a subsequence of t.

A string s is a subsequence of t if it can be formed by deleting some (or no) characters from t without changing the relative order of the remaining characters.

Example 1
Input:
abc
ahbgdc
Output: true

Example 2
Input:
axc
ahbgdc
Output: false

Example 3
Input:
-
ahbgdc
Output: true
(Note: '-' represents an empty string)
input_format: The first line contains string s and the second line contains string t. lowercase English letters (a-z) are used. If a string is empty, it is represented by a hyphen '-'.
output_format: Print 'true' if s is a subsequence of t, otherwise print 'false'.
